summary.en: From October 2026, bulky waste is anything that does not fit in the 45-litre designated bag (or cannot be tied shut). Items that fit go out as burnable, non-burnable or plastic waste. Umbrellas and frying pans are not bulky waste (to be checked). Book online (any time) or by phone at least 7 days before collection. After booking, either write your name or number on fee stickers (250/500 yen) and attach them, or pay by card or e-money online and tape your reception number (not your name) to the item. Put it out by 8:00 a.m. on collection day. Air conditioners, TVs, refrigerators, washing machines, dryers and home PCs are not collected by the city. Do not use collectors without a city permit.
